characters.name: luke_skywalker
characters.description: A real man, age 20. He has a slim build, fair skin with natural texture, and light blonde hair cut in a short, layered style that falls across his forehead. His face is oval-shaped with a straight, narrow nose, a defined jawline, and a small, neutral mouth. He has light blue eyes set beneath moderate, straight brows. His features are symmetrical, with a clean-shaven appearance and no visible scars or distinctive marks.

characters.name: han_solo
characters.description: A real man in his mid-30s with a medium build and light-tan skin. He has thick, dark brown hair cut in a layered, slightly shaggy style that falls around his ears and forehead. His face is oval-shaped with a prominent, straight nose, a firm jawline, and a slight, natural asymmetry in his mouth. He has heavy, dark brows over deep-set, dark eyes and a clean-shaven chin and upper lip.

characters.name: princess_leia_organa
characters.description: A real woman in her early twenties with a fair complexion and natural skin texture. She has a heart-shaped face, a small straight nose, and a defined jawline. Her dark brown hair is styled into two symmetrical, coiled buns positioned over each ear, with a center part. She has dark brown eyes, arched eyebrows, and a small, neutral mouth. Her build is slender, and her features are balanced with subtle, realistic asymmetries. She wears a plain white, floor-length, long-sleeved gown with a high rounded neckline and wide sleeves, with a narrow white fabric belt at the waist. Her neck, shoulders and arms are fully covered by the white fabric.

characters.name: grand_moff_tarkin
characters.description: A real man, age 60. He has pale, weathered skin with visible pores and fine lines around the eyes and mouth. His gray hair is thin, slicked back, and parted on the side. He has a gaunt face shape with prominent, high cheekbones, a broad forehead, and a thin, straight nose. His jawline is firm, his mouth is a thin, straight line, and his eyes are light-colored and deep-set beneath heavy, protruding brow ridges.

characters.name: obi_wan_ben_kenobi
characters.description: A real man, age 60-65. He has a pale, weathered complexion with visible fine lines around the eyes and mouth. He has a full, neatly trimmed white beard and mustache, and short, thinning white hair brushed back. His face is oval-shaped with a prominent, straight nose, a heavy brow, and deep-set, pale blue eyes. His jawline is soft but defined, and his skin texture shows natural pores and minor sun-spotted age marks.

characters.name: c_3po
characters.description: A mechanical robot with a polished, reflective gold-plated exterior. The head is a smooth rounded dome with two large round glowing yellow optical lenses and a fixed metal faceplate. The torso is segmented, with exposed wiring at the midsection and visible mechanical joints at the shoulders, elbows and knees. The surface shows minor scuffs and scratches.

characters.name: r2_d2
characters.description: A small, cylindrical astromech droid. The body consists of a white, drum-shaped chassis with recessed rectangular panels, vents, and circular ports. The top is a domed, rotating head featuring a prominent central circular lens, a smaller rectangular sensor array, and various metallic light indicators. The base is supported by two side-mounted legs with mechanical joints and a small, retractable central foot. The surface is weathered, featuring scuffs, scratches, and blue-painted accents on the panels and dome.

characters.name: chewbacca
characters.description: A seven-foot-tall Wookiee, an upright fur-covered alien who stands on two legs far taller than any human. Long, straight brown hair covers his whole body, from his head to his feet, and hangs down in loose strands. His face is mostly hair-covered, with a dark leathery nose, a wide mouth with a few visible teeth, and deep-set, warm blue eyes under a heavy brow, set in the same long brown hair. A dark leather bandolier crosses his chest from shoulder to hip, and he wears a small leather belt at his waist. His arms are long and thick and his hands are large.

characters.name: darth_vader
characters.description: A tall figure in glossy black armour and a full black helmet. The helmet is a smooth rounded dome with a flared rim at the back, a full-face mask with a downward-sloping triangular grille over the mouth and large dark angled lenses. Rigid black chest plating carries a small control panel with coloured buttons and horizontal light bars. Rounded black shoulder guards, a long black cape, black gloves and boots. No skin is visible.

characters.name: uncle_owen
characters.description: A real man, age 50-60. He has a medium build, a broad face with a square jawline, and a prominent, straight nose. His skin is weathered with visible pores and fine lines around the eyes and mouth. He has short, thinning brown hair with patches of gray, a high forehead, and a heavy brow over deep-set, serious eyes. His mouth is set in a firm, straight line, and he has a slight, natural asymmetry in his cheekbones.

characters.name: aunt_beru
characters.description: A real woman in her late 40s. She has a soft, oval face with light skin and a natural, even texture. Her hair is short, brown, and styled in a simple, tousled cut that frames her forehead. She has clear blue eyes, a straight, modest nose, and a soft jawline. Her eyebrows are thin and arched, and her mouth is small with a neutral expression. She has a gentle, approachable appearance with subtle, age-appropriate lines around her eyes.

characters.name: chief_jawa
characters.description: A small, non-human creature with a short, compact build. The face is entirely obscured by a deep, dark hood, revealing only two glowing, circular orange eyes set deep within the shadows. The skin, visible only around the eyes, is dark, leathery, and wrinkled with a rough, textured surface. It has long, thin, gloved hands and a small, rounded frame that is entirely concealed beneath heavy, textured, dark brown fabric.

characters.name: general_dodonna
characters.description: A real man in his late 50s. He has a medium build with a square face shape and a prominent, wide jawline. His skin is fair with natural age spots and fine wrinkles around the eyes. He has short, thinning white hair brushed back and a thick, well-groomed white mustache. His eyes are light blue, set beneath a heavy, straight brow. He has a broad, straight nose and thin, neutral lips.

characters.name: red_leader
characters.description: A real man, age 40. He has a square face, a prominent jawline, and a thick, dark brown mustache. His skin is fair with natural pores and slight sun-weathering. He has short, dark brown hair parted to the side. His eyes are deep-set with heavy lids, a straight, medium-width nose, and thin lips. His face shows subtle asymmetry, with a slightly deeper crease on the left side of his mouth.

characters.name: red_two
characters.description: A real man, age 30. He has a medium build, a square face shape with a prominent, firm jawline, and a broad, straight nose. His skin has a natural, slightly weathered texture with faint pores. He has short, straight brown hair parted to the side, a medium-high forehead, and straight, dark eyebrows over deep-set, hazel eyes. His mouth is medium-width with thin lips.

characters.name: red_three
characters.description: A real man in his late 20s. He has a medium build, a round face shape, and light skin with natural texture. His hair is light brown, short, and straight, parted on the side. He has blue eyes, thick eyebrows, a straight nose, and a thin-lipped mouth. His jawline is soft and rounded.

characters.name: red_four
characters.description: A real man in his late 20s. He has a medium build, a round face shape, and light-toned skin with natural texture. He has short, straight, light-brown hair parted to the side. His features include a low, straight brow, a short, rounded nose, and a thin-lipped mouth. His eyes are light blue, and his jawline is soft and rounded.

characters.name: red_six
characters.description: A real man, age 30. He has a medium build, a square face shape, and light olive skin with visible pores. His hair is dark brown, short, and straight, parted on the left with a slight cowlick. He has a broad, straight nose, a firm jawline, and thin lips. His eyebrows are thick and dark, set above deep-set, hazel eyes.

characters.name: gold_leader
characters.description: A real man in his late 30s. He has a medium build, a round face shape, and a light-to-medium skin tone with visible pores and natural texture. His hair is light brown, short, and straight, parted on the side. He has a broad, flat nose, a soft jawline, and thin lips. His eyes are light blue with heavy, drooping eyelids and prominent, slightly arched brows.

characters.name: gold_two
characters.description: A real man in his late 20s with a lean build and a square jawline. He has light olive skin with natural texture, short-cropped dark brown hair, and deep-set hazel eyes under straight, thick brows. His face is oval-shaped with a prominent, straight nose and thin, neutral lips.

characters.name: gold_five
characters.description: A real man in his late 20s. He has a lean, athletic build with a long, oval face shape. His skin is fair with a natural, matte texture. He has short, straight, light-brown hair parted to the side. His features include a prominent, straight nose, a defined jawline, and thin, pale lips. He has light blue eyes set beneath straight, moderate brows.

characters.name: general_taggi
characters.description: A real man in his late 50s. He has a medium build with a square face and a prominent, straight nose. His skin is pale with natural texture and subtle age lines around the eyes and mouth. He has short, straight, salt-and-pepper hair parted on the side. His eyes are light-colored under thick, straight brows. He has a firm, square jawline and thin lips. His features are symmetrical with a neutral, steady expression.

characters.name: general_motti
characters.description: A real man, age 40-50. He has a medium build, pale skin with natural texture, and short, dark brown hair slicked back from a high forehead. His face is oval-shaped with a prominent, straight nose, a firm jawline, and thin lips. He has deep-set, dark eyes under a heavy, straight brow, with subtle nasolabial folds and slight asymmetry in his cheekbones. His expression is neutral, with a clean-shaven face and visible pores.

characters.name: commander_1
characters.description: A real man, age 55. He has a medium build with a square face shape and pale, weathered skin showing fine lines around the eyes. His hair is short, straight, and silver-gray, parted on the left. He has a prominent, straight nose, a firm jawline with a slight cleft chin, and thin, neutral lips. His eyebrows are thick and gray, and his eyes are a pale, cool blue.

characters.name: stormtrooper
characters.description: A masked soldier in glossy white plastic armour. The helmet is smooth and rounded, with a black tapered 'T'-shaped visor, a short snout-like vent with horizontal black slats and black circular ear caps. Segmented white chest plate, rigid shoulder guards and limb plates over a black bodysuit, with black showing at the joints. No skin or face is visible.

characters.name: red_two_wedge_antilles
characters.description: A real man, approximately 25 to 30 years old. He has a medium build, a square face shape, and light skin with natural texture. His hair is short, straight, and light brown, parted to the side. He has blue eyes, a straight nose, and a defined jawline. His eyebrows are thick and straight, and his mouth is thin-lipped.
